description: This file provides utility functions for date formatting, parsing, and relative date resolution, specifically for use within the Mattermost project. It includes functions to format dates for display, convert strings to Moment objects, handle relative date references, and convert dates to ISO strings.

methods.name: formatDateForDisplay
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a locale-specific string for display, with fallback to ISO format.

methods.name: stringToMoment
methods.description: Converts a string (ISO or relative) to a Moment object, considering timezone.

methods.name: momentToString
methods.description: Converts a Moment object to an ISO string for storage, handling date and datetime formats.

methods.name: resolveRelativeDateToMoment
methods.description: Resolves relative date strings like 'today', 'tomorrow', or '+5d' to a Moment object.

methods.name: resolveRelativeDate
methods.description: Resolves relative date strings to ISO date strings.

methods.name: stringToDate
methods.description: Converts a string (ISO or relative) to a Date object.

methods.name: dateToString
methods.description: Converts a Date object to an ISO date string.
